_doc: 浮世万象 gameplay rules (engine-agnostic data). Setting: a fictional tier-1 Chinese city (架空一线城市), prices in RMB at 2026 tier-1 levels. Units: game minutes, money in yuan, needs 0..100, meters in 吨 / 度 / 立方. Read by rules.js (browser / node / port to GDScript). See README.md.

calendar._doc: real Gregorian dates: game day 0 = start_date. Weekends + 法定节假日 (with 调休 makeup workdays) follow the mainland pattern; dates modelled on the 2026/27 schedule (fictional city — individual dates may differ from the official notice).

conditions.label: 在跑步
conditions._doc: engine passes ctx.running while the player runs (~2.2x walk speed); below energy 'critical' the engine stops allowing running

money._doc: 李默 just moved in: paid 押一付一 for 2F-02 (deposit ¥850 + first month ¥850) from his savings; ¥1500 left on WeChat · balance (Stage 3 rebalance for the ¥850 room): 便利店 ¥18/h ≈ ¥3.5-4k/month full-time; rent+utilities+food ≈ ¥1.7-2k -> full-time saves, the 4 h evening part-time alone barely covers the month · Stage 4 rebalance: budget peripheral prices (see `prices`); a full-time clerk with normal habits saves roughly ¥1k/month, part-time alone is about break-even

prices._doc: ★ ALL PRICES IN ONE PLACE (¥). Edit numbers here only — at load the rules engine copies them onto actions[].cost / items[].price / the job and rewrites the （¥N） in labels. Level: peripheral old neighbourhood (城中村/老小区) in a tier-1 city, 2026. Rent itself lives in lease.rent / rent_table (2F-02 = ¥850).

store_clerk.label: 便利店店员
store_clerk._doc: hourly 便利店店员 (peripheral tier-1 2026: ~¥15–18/h, wage set in prices). 8 h shifts (+ a 4 h part-time peak shift); 夜班 +20%; 法定节假日 ×3 (劳动法第44条) · 下班可领一份员工价便当（prices.staff_meal，从工资扣）

booking._doc: 排班: book shifts with the manager up to max_ahead_days ahead; you can only clock in to a booked shift. A booked shift you never clock in to = 旷工 (mood hit + strike); fire_after strikes -> fired (apply again).

store_clerk._wage_note: ⚠ ¥15/h (prices.wage_per_h) is a gameplay choice to keep money tight. Real 2025–26 tier-1 legal minimums for part-time (非全日制) work are higher, roughly ¥24–28/h (e.g. Beijing ¥27.7/h, Shanghai ~¥25/h, Shenzhen ~¥23.7/h — check the current local notice). Raise wage_per_h in `prices` to make it realistic.

lease._doc: monthly rent on the move-in date (same day-of-month, clamped to month end); quarterly option = 押一付三. Paid by 微信转账 to the landlord automatically at due_min when the balance allows, retried every day; 3 grace days of reminders, then a late fee per day, an eviction warning only after a long default, and after evict_final_days the deposit is kept.

utilities._doc: metered from actions (`use`) + a daily base load (fridge, router, standby); billed on bill_day for the previous month together with fixed fees, auto-paid (代扣) if the balance allows, otherwise an open bill (pay at the property notice board). · v4: power comes from the appliances table (fridge / router always on, lights / PC / AC while switched on, induction / water heater / washer while the action runs); the bill is computed from the actual meters with tiered power prices.

power._doc: 阶梯电价（月用电量 度, 元/度）：一档 ≤260 度 0.62，二档 261–600 度 0.67，三档 >600 度 0.92（参考一线城市居民电价，可调）

utilities.payee: 物业 / 国网 / 燃气公司

transport._doc: metro fares by distance come with Stage 3

laundry._doc: clothes: clean / dirty counts + hours the current outfit has been worn. wash in the balcony machine (background, game time), hang on the enclosed balcony pole (always dries, slowly when humid) or the roof line (faster in sun, soaked by rain).

movement._doc: engine movement tunables shared by both lines

rent_table._doc: monthly rent by district for a 小单间 (single room, own bathroom) in this tier-1 city, per Leo: peripheral old blocks ~¥850, closer to the centre ~¥1200, CBD-adjacent far higher. lease.rent of a unit should fall inside its district range (test_rules checks 2F-02).

peripheral.label: 外环老小区（井槐里一带）

store._doc: 24便利店 interior (scene-proto-45 js/store.js · tools/test_store.js). Goods sold in the store: price_key looks the price up in `prices` (existing keys reused: bento ¥15, buy_oden ¥8, drink ¥4, milk ¥5, bread ¥6, bun ¥2, buy_coffee ¥9, cigs; new ones in the 'store · 便利店货架/冷柜' price group). Picked goods go into a basket and are paid at the counter (scan + 微信支付 / 支付宝 card); hot food / coffee are paid on the spot. item = inventory id when it is something you can carry home (fridge: eat_bento, drink_milk). eat = effects when eaten at the window bar (needs a free stool). Keys only added here — no existing value was changed.
store.label: 邻里便利 24h

hot._doc: paid on the spot (not via the basket): oden at the counter pot, coffee at the self-service machine (scan the QR on the machine). Effects = the existing actions buy_oden / buy_coffee; latte is new.

microwave._doc: heat a cold bento from the basket / inventory (free, self-service); the hot bento is placed on the window bar or taken away

bar._doc: eat at the window bar: sit on a free stool (shoppers also use them), eat one bought item (eat effects + eat_min). A heated bento gives +3 mood over a cold one (cold bento: hunger x0.8, mood -2).

shift._doc: store side of the job (rules: jobs.store_clerk — booking, check-in window, late cut, no-show strikes, task loop, pay). Task kinds -> what you do in the store: checkout = a shopper waits at the counter, scan their items at the counter from the staff lane (items x scan_s seconds); restock = the named shelf / fridge shows 'low', restock it (restock_min); mop = the trash corner is messy: tidy + mop (mop_min); oden = top up the pot (oden_min). Quality: done within half the deadline = 1.0, later = 0.7.
shift.uniform_note: 打卡时换上店服（员工室）

store._wage_note: ⚠ 店员时薪 = prices.wage_per_h（默认 ¥15/h，游戏性取值，让钱紧一点）。现实中一线城市非全日制最低小时工资更高（2025–26 约 ¥24–28/h：北京约 ¥27.7、上海约 ¥25、深圳约 ¥23.7，以当地最新公告为准），全日制月最低工资约 ¥2500–2700。想更真实就调高 prices.wage_per_h。

metro._doc: 地铁 metro (js/metro.js). Times in game minutes of the day, money in yuan. Fare by distance (km between stations), deducted on arrival (= tapping out). Built scenes: station.area (multi-area scenes in metro45.js); other stations are on the line but have no scene yet.

fare._doc: km travelled -> yuan (first band whose limit >= km)

headway_min._doc: minutes between trains per direction; peak = weekday peak windows, late = after late_after

metro._clock_doc: inside stations the clock runs at clock_scale game minutes per real second (6 game s per s; the street runs 1 min/s), so walking a station costs ~8-12 game minutes and a 1.2 min dwell is ~12 s to board

crowd._doc: waiting / walking NPCs per area = round(base * by_hour[h] * (weekend ? weekend_mul : 1)), capped at max. Kept lean so platforms stay walkable.

security._doc: 安检: bag through the X-ray + walk-through arch; skipping it is refused by staff

appliances._doc: per-appliance power metering (W). always: draws 24 h; others draw while switched on (s.power.on) or while an action that `runs` them lasts; w_busy = extra draw while busy (PC gaming / browsing). Edit freely.

households._doc: occupancy simulation per residential unit (every facade window maps to a household). schedule = [[start minute, state], ...] over a day (home / out / asleep); jitter_min shifts every boundary per unit per day (seeded); off days (weekends + holidays) use `off`; bad weather keeps daytime-out households home with p_weather_home. tv = chance of a TV glow while home in the evening. fixed: named units (井槐里12号 neighbours) -> profile.
households._lit_doc: home but this facade room dark (they sit in the back room / bed early): p_home_dark, shifted per building (± var_building/2) and per floor (± var_floor/2); p_room_dark = per-window chance a lit unit's other room is dark (core households.js)

cbd._doc: 云汇CBD (place 'cbd'). towers skyline density (Leo): ONLY 1 tower ≥600 m (天枢), 2 at 500–600 m, 5 at 400–500 m, 7 at 300–400 m; ALL other buildings ≤200 m (avg ~150 m), spaced with plazas. Top 15 have unique original silhouettes. Also: 云麓花园 vertical-forest compound (cream 四代住宅 + green balconies, villas+花树, grand gate/fountain, pool, basketball/soccer, kindergarten), riverside far N, atrium mall, Central-Park lake. metro_exits A–D → place metro_cbd.
